text:
Priya (Marketing): Quick note  aiming to publish a short launch notice for the 'Inference Tuning Guide' next Tue 9:00 AM PT. Need legal + PR signoff by Mon EOD. Draft is in /marketing/drafts/tuning-guide.md

Evan (PR): Recommend embargo 8:30 AM PT and a small press kit (one-pager + hi-res chart). I'll prepare the outreach list. Do we want a partner teaser?

Marta (Legal): I'll review tonight. Please avoid absolute claims like 'guaranteed savings' and add a methodology footnote.

Noah (Product): Uploaded chart to /marketing/assets/tuning-chart.png and added a short footnote: "Benchmarks run on our standard harness; results may vary."

Priya (Marketing): Checklist: legal signoff (Marta), PR outreach (Evan), chart asset (Noah), analytics ID from infra, schedule publish (PressOps Bot).

PressOps Bot: Publish job created: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-09-15T16:00:00Z, embargo_until=2026-09-15T15:30:00Z, job_id=130900.

Marta (Legal): :thumbsup: wording updated; removed 'guaranteed' and added footnote.

Evan (PR): :thumbsup: will share press list shortly and hold outreach until embargo window.

Noah (Product): :thumbsup: chart confirmed.

Priya (Marketing): :thumbsup: thanks all, will monitor on publish day and confirm internal announce.
